item.message: Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled. Code mode will fail closed; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.

item.text: {"rule":"The first instruction determined which two cats remained (the petted pair when they stayed, otherwise the unpetted pair). The final cat was then determined by the second instruction: it was the cat petted when that cat stayed, or the other remaining cat when the petted cat left."}
